name: segment
description: Segment (Twilio) customer data — no first-party MCP server; community server or native Tracking API

requirements: Workspace access token (or a source write key for the Tracking API)
Trust in the community package publisher before granting a token
notes: Segment has NO official workspace MCP server. The only first-party MCP is Twilio’s docs search server (https://mcp.twilio.com/docs, 2 tools) — it never calls an API.

The closest wrapper is segment-mcp-server@1.0.0 (single maintainer, no repo, unpublished source) — treat it as a dependency you own. Alternatives: segment-mcp (katekruger), @pipeworx/mcp-segment, io.usefulapi/segment.
Segment needs three different credential types: Public API bearer token, Tracking API source write key, and a per-space Profiles token.
Dry-run: use a Segment test-mode source write key; GET-then-diff before config writes.
